utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can ask around and see who still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Ira. Keep it simple and let’s make sure the people who still need help get on the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep it simple and ask around for the folks who still need help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What’s the repair drive needing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly wiring and a loose hinge. I can show you where I left the parts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, show me and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely still on for tonight, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d like to double-check the timing and what still needs to be moved.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm the timing before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I may be a bit foggy, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a little stock set aside for repairs, so let me know what you need and I’ll check what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll think it through and come back with exactly what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think the front gate and a couple of loose boards need fixing, but I may have missed something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll check whether there’s anything else that needs fixing before we start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now. What still needs doing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the cleanup and hauling now, but if you can help sort the tools and check the back room, that would really move it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that. I’ll sort the tools and check the back room first, then help with hauling.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll grab my tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive location. Where are we meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m heading to the school parking lot by the gym entrance. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll meet you by the gym entrance at the school parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that repair drive? I heard folks are still signing up, and they could really use a few more hands by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I heard they could use a couple people who aren’t afraid of a little hammer work. Might be worth swinging by before lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can cover part of it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you think you still need?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll check on the repair drive and let people know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik. Can you let me know the plan once you hear back?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure we’ve got the next steps covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli. I’ll keep things moving and let you know if anything needs your attention.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up steam this week, and folks are supposed to drop off supplies by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I heard they still need a few more tools and canned goods, so I’m telling folks to check their garages before Friday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left to do on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just a few things left: we still need to sort the donated parts and finish the last two repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can take the donated parts, then we just have those last two repairs to finish.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The front brake on my bike keeps slipping. I can show you where it’s acting up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Show me where it slips, and I’ll take a look with you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What’s left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still need the repair list and where the materials are being dropped off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll grab the repair list and confirm the drop-off spot so you have both.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon. Want me to help connect you with the right folks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help, thanks. I’d like to make sure I’m connecting with the right people before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can introduce you to the right people and keep it simple. I’ll make sure you’re talking to folks who are actually involved before you commit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I heard something about it, but I may have missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, it’s the neighborhood repair drive this weekend. I can send you the details and the sign-up info if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send them over—I’d like the details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along. Need anything from the hardware store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Could you grab a box of screws and a roll of duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help, Leo. What needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly furniture and a leaky sink. I can show you the list at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can help with that list when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and whether we have enough people lined up to make the repair drive work.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should confirm the schedule and line up a few more people before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about it tonight. Come by if you can; we could use a few more hands for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Count me in. I can bring some supplies and help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear, Cleo. I’ll add you to the list and see you there tonight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check my calendar for the school pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No rush at all, Faye. Let me know what your calendar says, and I can keep the repair drive on the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I just checked my calendar, and I can help after the school pickup window.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I can make sure we match each need with the right volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you. I’ll put you down where you’re most needed and keep the list moving.
